title: Modality Map — Every Klein Face the Browser Can Open
thesis: The browser is a window. But a window has SIX faces: screen (light out), speaker (sound out), microphone (sound in), keyboard/mouse (touch in), share (bits to other humans), haptic (vibration out). The HUD only had screen open. Now all faces unlock. Each face is a Klein fold: digital ? analog, no inside, no outside.

the_machine.gpu_primary: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (4GB reported via WMI, actual 32GB GDDR7)

audio_topology.note: 8 audio devices. Each is a Klein fold point: bits ? sound wave.

SCREEN.note: The first and oldest face. Every web page ever made opens this face.

SPEAKER.direction: bits ? DAC ? speaker cone ? air ? ear
capabilities: Spatial audio (HRTF — sounds from specific 3D positions)
Audio routing to specific output device (setSinkId)
Audio analysis (listen to room, detect heartbeat, ambient noise level)

HAPTIC.note: Desktop has no vibration motor. Phone does. The mobile version gets this face free.

capabilities: Web Share API (native share sheet on mobile — Twitter, Discord, etc.)

Picture-in-Picture (float the HUD over other windows)

WAKE.note: Prevents screen from sleeping. Essential for ambient display / dashboard mode.

pwa_install.what: Progressive Web App — the browser becomes the app

desktop.how: Chrome/Edge: click install icon in address bar, or ? menu ? 'Install HUD'
desktop.result: HUD runs in its own window. No address bar. No tabs. Looks like a native app. Has its own taskbar icon. Can be pinned to Start.
desktop.display_mode: standalone (with window-controls-overlay for title bar integration)

mobile.how: Chrome Android: ? ? 'Add to Home screen' / 'Install app'. Safari iOS: Share ? 'Add to Home Screen'
mobile.result: HUD is a card on home screen. Opens fullscreen. No Safari chrome. Push notifications. Works offline via service worker.
mobile.note: The 'mobile version' IS the browser card. Same code, responsive layout, touch events, haptic feedback.

modality_unlock_sequence.step_2: Web Audio API ? sound output to any device, spatial audio, sonification

the_principle.browser_as_klein_face: The browser window IS already a Klein fold. Screen was the only face open. Every new API we wire in opens another face. Sound, touch, share, wake — each is a fold point where digital meets analog. The app.webmanifest makes it installable. The service worker makes it offline. The modality engine makes it multimodal. Same code. Every device. Every face.
the_principle.mobile_is_desktop: There is no 'mobile version' and 'desktop version'. There's ONE membrane. The screen face adjusts (responsive CSS). The haptic face only works on mobile. The GPU face is stronger on desktop. But it's the SAME organism viewed through different folds.
the_principle.sound_routing: Web Audio API can target specific output devices via setSinkId(). Route heartbeat to headset (private). Route campfire stories to monitor speakers (room). Route notification pings to both. The SAME audio engine, different fold points.
